What I fix

What makes your customers leave, I fix

  1. Your idea doesn't exist yet

    Every month without a product helps your competitors, and a wrong technical choice at the start costs you for years.

    A useful first version, an architecture that holds, and publication on the stores.

  2. Your app breaks in production

    Payment fails on a Friday night and your customers notice before you do.

    Automated tests on the paths that bring money, checked releases, instant rollback.

  3. Nobody understands the code anymore

    Every fix breaks something else, and the announced migration was never done.

    A clear audit, a migration plan in small steps, and tests as a safety net.

  4. Your users wait, then leave

    Three seconds too many or a dropped network: they uninstall without a word.

    Screens that respond, even on a small phone and an unstable network.

  5. Your notifications don't arrive

    A missed ride, a payment confirmed without anyone knowing, or so many messages that the app gets muted.

    Reliable push notifications, sorted by channel, with reminders that don't wear people out.

Let's talk about your project

Method

No surprises, from the first call to launch

  1. 01

    We talk about your customers

    A first call to understand the real need, before any line of code.

    • Who your users are and what they must be able to do
    • Your constraints: deadlines, budget, stores, payment methods
    • What success means for you

    You getA written summary of needs and priorities

  2. 02

    I study what exists, or I design

    Depending on your situation, I start from your code or from a blank page.

    • Existing app: I read the code, the database and the release setup
    • Risks ranked from most to least urgent
    • New project: technical choices, data, web, mobile and API split

    You getA clear action plan

  3. 03

    We break it into steps

    No long tunnel: every step delivers something you can try.

    • Essential paths first: signup, ordering, payment
    • One short step at a time, approved with you
    • Priorities adjusted after each delivery

    You getA step-by-step schedule

  4. 04

    I build and test

    The code moves in small deliveries, with tests on what matters.

    • Automated tests on signup, payment and notifications
    • Every fixed bug becomes a test so it never comes back
    • A test version you open on your phone or browser

    You getA testable version at every step

  5. 05

    I launch without risk

    The release is prepared, checked and reversible.

    • Docker images built automatically
    • New version checked before the switch, old one ready for rollback
    • Publishing on Google Play, the App Store or the Amazon Appstore if needed

    You getYour app live, used by your customers

  6. 06

    I monitor and hand over

    After launch, I keep an eye on it and leave you autonomous.

    • Error alerts on app and server with Sentry
    • Quick fixes for reported issues
    • Documentation and handover of access

    You getA monitored app and an autonomous team
